video_title: Inside My Penthouse As A 24 Year Old NBA Player!

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on his first career points against the Denver Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: my first actual basket was against Denver
quotes.quote: This is my first point. My first point was actually a free throw. Then my first actual basket was against Denver. They paint the ball and everything and then give it to you, so that's cool. I got to get a new case though, because this one got broke during the move.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark regrets buying an expensive Chrome Hearts jacket
quotes.excerpt: This Chrome Hearts jacket is definitely my dumbest purchase
quotes.quote: My dumbest purchase as an NBA player is actually right here. This Chrome Hearts jacket is definitely my dumbest purchase. I was hanging out with Jaden McDaniels in France, and he told me he didn't know how much the jacket cost. He thought it was a thousand dollars. The jacket was not a thousand dollars, but at that point I was already at the register and lowkey got peer pressured into buying it.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark receives his first Minnesota Vikings jersey
quotes.excerpt: I just went to a Vikings game actually, and they finally gave me my own jersey
quotes.quote: I just went to a Vikings game actually, and they finally gave me my own jersey. That's how I know I'm finally doing something right in Minnesota, because I've been to a million Vikings games and they never gave me a jersey.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on his signed Russell Westbrook jersey
quotes.excerpt: Russell Westbrook is probably the coolest signed jersey that I have
quotes.quote: I got a Westbrook jersey. Shout out to the OG, he just retired. Russell Westbrook is probably the coolest signed jersey that I have.
